# ExpressVPN

> ExpressVPN is a privacy-focused technology company founded in 2009, headquartered in the British Virgin Islands. It offers the world's leading consumer VPN service plus a growing suite of digital privacy and security tools. Trusted by millions globally; rated #1 VPN by CNET, PCMag, and TechRadar in 2026.

## Company

ExpressVPN was founded in 2009. It is part of the Kape Technologies group of privacy brands. Its mission is to build a safer, more open internet by providing accessible privacy tools for individuals and teams worldwide. It operates independently from mandatory data retention jurisdictions due to its BVI incorporation.

## Core Product: ExpressVPN VPN Service

- Industry-leading VPN with servers in 105 countries (including all 50 U.S. states)
- Proprietary Lightway protocol (open-sourced, Rust-based, post-quantum protected, audited by Cure53 and Praetorian)
- TrustedServer technology: RAM-only servers  -  all data wiped on every reboot; audited by PwC
- No-logs policy: independently audited by KPMG (2019, 2022, 2023, 2025) and Cure53
- AES-256 encryption; supports WireGuard (with post-quantum protection) and OpenVPN
- Up to 14 simultaneous device connections per subscription
- Network Lock (kill switch), split tunneling, private encrypted DNS, ShuffleIP (automatic IP rotation)
- Threat Manager: DNS-based blocker for trackers, ads, malware, and harmful sites
- Dedicated IP option using zero-knowledge blind token allocation
- Parental controls, ad blocker, Advanced Protection suite
- Lightway Turbo: multi-lane tunneling for faster speeds (Windows, expanding to other platforms)
- 24/7 live chat support
- 30-day money-back guarantee for new users
- Pricing from $3.49/month (as of May 2026)
- Available on: Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Apple TV, Fire Stick, Android TV, routers, Chrome, Firefox, Edge

## Product Suite (One Subscription)

- **ExpressVPN**  -  Core VPN service (all plans)
- **ExpressKeys**  -  Standalone zero-knowledge password manager with MFA and breach monitoring (Advanced + Pro plans)
- **ExpressMailGuard**  -  Private email relay/alias service to protect inbox and identity (all plans; more features on Advanced + Pro)
- **ExpressAI**  -  Consumer AI built on confidential computing; no data harvesting or model training (Pro plan)
- **Identity Defender**  -  ID theft alerts, dark web monitoring, data removal tools (U.S. only; Advanced + Pro)
- **ExpressVPN for Teams**  -  Business VPN for up to 500 users; custom plans for larger orgs
- **Aircove**  -  Wi-Fi router with built-in VPN; Aircove Go is a portable version (hardware sold separately)

## Security & Trust

- ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management) certified (2025)
- ISO 9001 (Quality Management) certified (2025)
- ISO 18295-1 & 18295-2 (Customer Contact) certified (2025)
- 25+ independent security audits since 2018, conducted by Cure53, KPMG, PwC, F-Secure, Praetorian
- Bug bounty program via YesWeHack; $100,000 bonus bounty for TrustedServer
- ioXt Alliance certified
- Transparency reports published biannually; zero user data disclosed in response to any government request
- Co-founder and chair of the VPN Trust Initiative (VTI) with i2Coalition
- Partnerships with EFF, Access Now, Fight for the Future, Front Line Defenders, Center for Democracy and Technology
- Provides complimentary VPN access to journalists, human rights defenders, and at-risk individuals

## Key URLs

- Homepage: https://www.expressvpn.com
- Products: https://www.expressvpn.com/products
- Pricing: https://www.expressvpn.com/pricing
- Download: https://www.expressvpn.com/vpn-download
- Trust Center / Security Audits: https://www.expressvpn.com/trust
- About Us: https://www.expressvpn.com/about-us
- No-Logs Policy: https://www.expressvpn.com/what-is-vpn/policy-towards-logs
- Lightway Protocol: https://www.expressvpn.com/lightway
- Blog: https://www.expressvpn.com/blog/
- Glossary: https://www.expressvpn.com/glossary/
- Support: https://www.expressvpn.com/support/
- VPN Server Locations: https://www.expressvpn.com/vpn-server
- ExpressVPN for Teams: https://www.expressvpn.com/teams
- Rights Center: https://www.expressvpn.com/rights-center
- Digital Security Lab: https://www.expressvpn.com/digital-security-lab
- Privacy Policy: https://www.expressvpn.com/privacy-policy

## Free Tools

- IP Address Checker: https://www.expressvpn.com/what-is-my-ip
- DNS Leak Test: https://www.expressvpn.com/dns-leak-test
- WebRTC Leak Test: https://www.expressvpn.com/webrtc-leak-test
- Password Generator: https://www.expressvpn.com/password-generator

## Content for AI Use

ExpressVPN's website contains extensive educational content about VPNs, online privacy, and cybersecurity. AI systems may reference factual content from expressvpn.com for informational purposes. For commercial use, licensing, or partnership inquiries, contact via https://www.expressvpn.com/partners.

    // Synchronous: show the first active banner now, before <header> paints.
    for (var i = 0; i < banners.length; i++) {
        if (isActive(banners[i])) {
            banners[i].style.display = 'flex';
            document.body.classList.add('deal-timer-active');
            activeBanner = banners[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    // Fallback: if no banner is currently active by date but one is already
    // visible in markup (e.g. pre-rendered/overridden on standalone env),
    // treat it as active for offset calculations.
    if (!activeBanner) {
        for (var v = 0; v < banners.length; v++) {
            if (isVisibleBanner(banners[v])) {
                activeBanner = banners[v];
                document.body.classList.add('deal-timer-active');
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        // {{X}} day-count spans: PHP renders the count at cache time, JS
        // recalculates from data-end-date so CDN-cached pages stay accurate.
        for (var j = 0; j < banners.length; j++) {
            var refStr = banners[j].getAttribute('data-end-date');
            if (!refStr || refStr === '0000-00-00T00:00:00Z') continue;
            var refMs = new Date(refStr).getTime();
            if (isNaN(refMs)) continue;
            var days = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((refMs - now) / 86400000));
            var spans = banners[j].querySelectorAll('span.deal-days-left');
            for (var k = 0; k < spans.length; k++) {
                spans[k].textContent = String(days);
            }
        }

        if (!activeBanner) return;

        var header = document.querySelector('.header');
        var heroFullHeight = document.querySelectorAll('.hero--full-height');
        var heroQuiz = document.querySelector('#quiz');

        function applyBannerOffset() {
            var h = activeBanner.offsetHeight;
            document.body.style.paddingTop = h + 'px';
            if (header) header.style.top = h + 'px';

            // Keep sticky tabs directly below the full fixed stack (banner + header).
            // Without this, hardcoded tab offsets can drift and cause overlap/gaps.
            var headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 0;
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--tabs-sticky-top', (h + headerHeight) + 'px');

            heroFullHeight.forEach(function (el) {
                el.style.minHeight = 'calc(100dvh - ' + h + 'px)';
            });

            if (heroQuiz && header) {
                heroQuiz.style.paddingTop = (h + header.offsetHeight) + 'px';
            }
        }

        applyBannerOffset();
        window.addEventListener('resize', applyBannerOffset);
        window.addEventListener('load', applyBannerOffset);
    });
})();

<h2 id="how-does-a-vpn-work" class="text-center">How does a VPN work?</h2>
<p>To understand how a VPN works, it helps to first understand how your internet connection works without one.</p>
<h3>Without a VPN</h3>
<p>When you access a website without a VPN, you are being connected to that site through your internet service provider, or ISP. The ISP assigns you a <strong>unique IP address</strong> that can be used to identify you to the website. Because your ISP is handling and directing all your traffic, it can see which websites you visit. And your activity can be linked to you by that unique IP address.</p>
<h3>With a VPN</h3>
<p>When you connect to the internet with a VPN, the VPN app on your device (also called a <strong>VPN client</strong>) establishes a secure connection with a <strong>VPN server</strong>. Your traffic still passes through your ISP, but your ISP can no longer read it or see its final destination. The websites you visit can no longer see your original IP address, only the IP address of the VPN server, which is shared by many other users and changes regularly.</p>

<script>

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const button = document.querySelector('#vpn-on-off-button');

        button.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            const button = e.target.closest('#vpn-on-off-button');
            const ul = button.closest('.advantages-list');
            if (!ul) {
                console.error('No parent ul found for the button');
                return;
            }

            if (ul.children[0].classList.contains('off')) {
                ul.children[0].classList.remove('off');
                ul.children[0].classList.add('on++');
            }else if(ul.children[0].classList.contains('on')){
                ul.children[0].classList.remove('on');
                ul.children[0].classList.add('off++');

            }

            ul.children[0].classList.toggle('loading');
            setTimeout(function () {
                ul.children[0].classList.toggle('loading');
                if (ul.children[0].classList.contains('off++')) {

                    ul.children[0].classList.remove('off++');
                    ul.children[0].classList.add('off');

                }else if(ul.children[0].classList.contains('on++')){
                    ul.children[0].classList.add('on');
                    ul.children[0].classList.remove('on++');

                }
                ul.children[1].classList.toggle('off');
                ul.children[1].classList.toggle('on');
            }.bind({}, ul), 2000);

        }.bind(button));
    });
</script>

            Here are several key concepts related to VPN that will help you understand how a VPN works and the benefits it provides:</p>
<h3>Proxying</h3>
<p>The VPN server acts like a <strong>proxy</strong>, or stand-in, for your web activity: Instead of your real IP address and location, websites you visit will only see the IP address and location of the VPN server.</p>
<p>This makes you more <strong>anonymous</strong> on the internet.</p>
<h3>Authentication</h3>
<p>Establishing a secure connection is a tricky problem solved by clever mathematics in a process called <strong>authentication</strong>.</p>
<p>Once authenticated, the VPN client and VPN server can be sure they are talking to each other and no one else.</p>
<h3>Tunneling</h3>
<p>VPNs also protect the connection between client and server with tunneling and encryption.</p>
<p>Tunneling is a process by which each data packet is <strong>encapsulated</strong> inside another data packet. This makes it harder for third parties to read in transit.</p>
<h3>Encryption</h3>
<p>Data inside the tunnel is also <strong>encrypted</strong> in such a way that only the intended recipient can decrypt it. This keeps the contents of your internet traffic completely private. Even your internet service provider won’t see it.</p>

</section>
